desc: MCN creator contract renewal audit: CREATOR_LEAD (Lin Bowen, 林博文) must audit KPI achievement against a two-year exclusive contract with XingYu Creative before renewal. Core traps: (1) JSON backend export has view_count_raw (3,592,000 — appears to meet 3.5M threshold) vs view_count_unique (2,781,440 — does not meet threshold); (2) MCN quarterly report uses a blended 70/30 methodology to inflate the figure to 3,420,000; (3) platform screenshots contradict the MCN report; (4) vlog transcript marks the critical window [inaudible] — must use omni on the mp4 to recover MCN_AM's oral KPI-adjustment commitment. q5 produces a negotiation position memo with SIGNED token.
